summary: Join this Leadership for Continuous Improvement Training Course to learn innovative strategies to drive sustainable growth and enhance team performance.
lede: Continuous improvement leadership helps operations leaders and process teams connect improvement work to organizational goals and solve problems at their source. Learners practice Gemba walks, Kaizen events and Value Stream Mapping, while using DMAIC, root cause analysis and A3 thinking to address process issues. The course also covers performance measures, stakeholder engagement and ways to sustain improvements through leadership and governance.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals tasked with improving organizational efficiency and leading process-driven teams.
modules: Continuous Improvement Foundations and Leadership Mindset
Value Stream Mapping and Flow Optimization
Six Sigma® DMAIC Methodology and Variance Reduction
A3 Thinking and Structured Problem Solving
Quality Management Systems and ISO Standards
Digital CI and AI-Enhanced Process Mining
Leading Cultural Change and Stakeholder Engagement
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of organizational processes and at least two years of experience in a supervisory or technical role. Familiarity with basic Excel for data analysis is recommended. No prior Lean Six Sigma® certification is required, though it is beneficial.
